import pandas as pd
import subprocess
import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

# Ensure lifelines is available
try:
    from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
    from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test
except ImportError:
    install("lifelines")
    from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
    from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv("cleaned_clinical_data.csv")
mutations = pd.read_csv("cleaned_mutations.csv")

# 2. Compute nonsynonymous TMB per patient
nonsyn_classes = [
    "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Splice_Site",
    "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del",
    "In_Frame_Ins", "Nonstop_Mutation", "Translation_Start_Site"
]
mut_ns = mutations[mutations["Variant_Classification"].isin(nonsyn_classes)]
tmb = mut_ns.groupby("patient_id").size().reset_index(name="nonsyn_count")
tmb["TMB"] = tmb["nonsyn_count"] / 30.0

# 3. Prepare clinical survival data
# Derive patient_id from barcode (first 12 chars)
clinical["patient_id"] = clinical["bcr_patient_barcode"].str.slice(0, 12)
# Determine time and event
clinical["time"] = clinical.apply(
    lambda row: row["days_to_death"] if pd.notna(row["days_to_death"]) else row["days_to_last_followup"],
    axis=1
)
clinical["event"] = clinical["days_to_death"].notna().astype(int)

# 4. Merge TMB into clinical
df = pd.merge(clinical, tmb[["patient_id", "TMB"]], on="patient_id", how="inner")
# Drop missing times or TMB
df = df.dropna(subset=["time", "TMB"])

# 5. Dichotomize TMB at median
median_tmb = df["TMB"].median()
print(f"Cohort median TMB: {median_tmb:.2f} mutations/Mb")
df["TMB_group"] = df["TMB"].apply(lambda x: "High" if x > median_tmb else "Low")

# 6. Fit Kaplan-Meier curves and log-rank test
kmf_low = KaplanMeierFitter()
kmf_high = KaplanMeierFitter()
data_low = df[df["TMB_group"] == "Low"]
data_high = df[df["TMB_group"] == "High"]

kmf_low.fit(durations=data_low["time"], event_observed=data_low["event"], label="Low TMB")
kmf_high.fit(durations=data_high["time"], event_observed=data_high["event"], label="High TMB")

# Log-rank test
result = logrank_test(
    data_high["time"], data_low["time"],
    event_observed_A=data_high["event"], event_observed_B=data_low["event"]
)
print(f"Log-rank test: statistic = {result.test_statistic:.2f}, p-value = {result.p_value:.4f}")

# 7. Median survival times
med_low = kmf_low.median_survival_time_
med_high = kmf_high.median_survival_time_
print(f"Median survival time (Low TMB): {med_low:.1f} days")
print(f"Median survival time (High TMB): {med_high:.1f} days")

# 8. Plot KM curves
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
ax = plt.subplot(111)
kmf_low.plot_survival_function(ax=ax, ci_show=True)
kmf_high.plot_survival_function(ax=ax, ci_show=True)
plt.title("Kaplan-Meier Survival by TMB Group")
plt.xlabel("Time (days)")
plt.ylabel("Survival Probability")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
